question: Can C-0086's 112 bp seamless raster row be twist-corrected, and what does the correction leave for C-0107's row-end prestrain and C-0090's placement?

conditions.sheet: single-layer square-lattice Rothemund, 15 duplexes at 2.69 nm, 0.34 nm rise
conditions.widths: 38.08 nm (C-0086's 112 bp) against 37.4 nm (the 110 bp twist-corrected row)
conditions.load: C-0022's solved collar at 2 mM, a 10 nm gap and 0.192 V
conditions.coupling: C-0017's 33.3333333 pN/nm shared equally over 34 roots

lattices.name: the 110 bp corrected row, 8 bp planes
the 110 bp corrected row, MIRRORED planes

dishing.state: zero prestrain, at C-0090's own placement SHAPE
the corrected graded field, at C-0090's SHAPE

reproductions.what: C-0090's 34-root dishing at 38.08 nm / phase 8, on the generalised column layout
C-0107's graded-field dishing at 112 bp, its continuum against this discrete chain
EdgeTwistRelief's own discrete end residual on seven equal domains
C-0107's un-relieved accumulation over C-0086's 112 bp row, in degrees
the residual ratio between C-0086's row and the twist-corrected floor
the station census, 112 bp against 110 bp
the generalised upward lattice against rasterUpwardSites, worst station in nm
the generalised column layout against rasterColumnLayout, worst column in nm
the generalised enumerator's family size against C-0063's own
the register field is exactly linear in the twist mismatch (half gives half)

predicates.statement: the closed-form enumeration of seamless twist-corrected rows is delivered before any solve, with the incompatibility stated as a theorem
a construction near Sec 3's 40 nm exists: 110 bp = 37.40 nm over seven domains, five of 16 bp and two of 15
the row-end register is re-read over C-0107's own 12-cell bracket and the linearity in the mismatch is proved rather than swept
C-0090's placement is re-read on the corrected lattice and the question whether the DESIGN or only its VALUE moves is answered

falsifiers.outcome: did not fire: 0 of 2001 odd half-turn counts land on an integer base pair

falsifiers.outcome: did not fire: the residual is 0.25 bp at all 201 counts tested, exactly

falsifiers.outcome: did not fire: columns, stations and the enumerated family all reproduce exactly

falsifiers.statement: the register field is not exactly proportional to the twist mismatch
falsifiers.outcome: did not fire: halving the mismatch halves every node to 0.0e+00

falsifiers.statement: the twist-corrected row's ROW-END register still exceeds C-0104's threshold
falsifiers.outcome: did not fire: the corrected row end carries -3.5581 to -2.1903 deg against 15.4497

falsifiers.statement: the twist-corrected row's PEAK register, wherever it sits, exceeds the threshold
falsifiers.outcome: did not fire, but only just: the interior peak is 12.3708 to 12.8400 deg against 15.4497, where the row end is under 4

falsifiers.statement: a free plate under a uniform load on a uniform Winkler foundation dishes something
falsifiers.outcome: did not fire: the largest uniform-load dishing over 4 states is 2.13e-07

findings: THE TWO QUANTISATIONS ARE EXACTLY INCOMPATIBLE, AND IT IS ONE LINE. A seamless boustrophedon needs its row to be an ODD number of half turns; a twist correction needs those half turns to be B-DNA's. Together N = 180 q/34.2857 = 21q/4 with q odd, and 21q is odd, so N is NEVER an integer. No row length, at no domain mix, is exactly twist-corrected AND seamless. F1 did not fire over 2001 odd half-turn counts.

BUT THE RESIDUAL IS AN INVARIANT AND IT IS A QUARTER OF A BASE PAIR. Because 21q is odd, the nearest integer to 21q/4 is exactly 0.25 away at EVERY odd q — so the best twist-corrected seamless row carries exactly 0.25 x 34.2857 = 8.5714 deg of accumulated twist across the whole tile, INDEPENDENTLY OF ITS WIDTH. C-0086's 112 bp row sits 1.75 bp away and carries 60.0 deg: exactly 7 times, a ratio of two integers rather than a computed number. F2 did not fire.

THE CONSTRUCTION EXISTS AND IT IS 110 bp = 37.40 nm. Seven domains, q = 21 half turns, five of 16 bp and two of 15 — which is Rothemund's own remedy ("helical domain lengths ... by single bases") and Snodin's measured mix read on the crossover spacing this project uses: the per-interface spacings come out 31,31,32,32,31,31, i.e. Snodin's 31 bp between equivalent junctions beside the square lattice's nominal 32. It is 1.8 % narrower than C-0086's 112 bp row and 6.5 % below Sec 3's 40.0 nm.

THE ARRANGEMENT OF THE TWO SHORT DOMAINS IS A DESIGN VARIABLE WORTH 2.23x, AND THE OBVIOUS RULE IS NOT THE BEST ONE. Over the 21 arrangements the peak register runs 12.7746 to 28.5441 deg; over the three CENTRO-SYMMETRIC ones it runs 12.7746 to 18.3388, and the best is 16+15+16+16+16+15+16 — short domains at the SECOND and SIXTH positions, not the innermost pair a naive even split gives.

THE ROW-END PRESTRAIN IS REMOVED, AND ITS SIGN FLIPS. Over C-0107's own 2 x 3 x 2 bracket the row end carries -3.5581 to -2.1903 deg on the corrected row against 16.6754 to 24.7889 on C-0086's, all twelve below C-0104's 15.4497 where all twelve were above it. The sign reverses because a 110 bp row is OVERtwisted by its own lattice where a 112 bp row is undertwisted. F5 did not fire.

BUT THE STRAIN IS RELOCATED, NOT REMOVED, AND THAT IS THE FINDING. A 15 bp domain is 25.714 deg short of the 540 deg its two crossovers demand, and that error is LOCAL: the corrected row's peak register is 12.3708 to 12.8400 deg and it sits in the INTERIOR, at the columns flanking the short domains, where C-0086's row has its peak at the ends. Peak against peak the correction is worth only 1.93x, against 7x on the accumulated twist. A twist correction converts a GLOBAL, one-signed, coherent driver into a LOCAL, alternating one — which is why the flatness moves so much more than the peak angle does.

AND THE CORRECTED FIELD IS NEARLY INSENSITIVE TO THE PARAMETERS C-0107 HAD TO BRACKET. The peak register spans 3.65 % over the whole 2 x 3 x 2 (C, alpha, p) sweep against 32.7 % for C-0086's row, because a local per-domain strain is taken by the hinges at its own two columns while a global accumulation is set by the boundary layer's decay length. The twist correction removes the parameter uncertainty as well as the value.

THE CORRECTION COSTS THE STATION LATTICE'S CENTRO-SYMMETRY UNLESS THE OUT-OF-PLANE OFFSET IS MIRRORED, AND MIRRORING COSTS AZIMUTH. The EAST site sits 8 bp past its column, which is not mirror-symmetric inside an ODD domain: taken at 8 bp everywhere the 110 bp station lattice is NOT centro-symmetric, and C-0063's whole exhaustive family assumes it is. Mirroring the offsets right of centre restores it exactly and puts 8 of 52 stations at a 7 bp offset, whose azimuth departure is -30.00 deg against 4.29 deg at 8 bp. The station COUNT is unchanged at 52.

AND IT COSTS ONE BASE PAIR OF ARM, BECAUSE C-0090'S PLAN CLEARANCE WAS ALREADY ZERO. C-0090 records that at 38.08 nm the outboard bound owns the plan budget and C-0085's 24-rise arm is EXACTLY tangent. A 110 bp row moves every station 0.34 nm inboard, so the 34-root centro-symmetric family is EMPTY at 24 rises and the largest arm that admits it is 23 rises = 7.8200 nm, against 24 rises = 8.1600 nm at 112 bp. A twist correction is therefore not free in the plan: it spends the arm length C-0034's placement condition is written on.

AND THE FLATNESS BARELY MOVES, WHICH IS THE RESULT THIS TASK EXISTS TO REPORT. Read at C-0090's own placement SHAPE on both lattices, the prestrain's CONTRIBUTION to the dishing is +0.0298053 of the stroke at 112 bp and +0.0278928 at the twist-corrected 110 bp — a factor of 1.07, against 7x on the accumulated twist and 1.93x on the peak angle. The reason is that dishing is driven by the whole crossover prestrain FIELD, not by its row-end value: the corrected field is a sawtooth of 9.11 deg RMS against the uncorrected boundary layer's 14.08. CLAUDE.md's own "a mandate written on a SUM is not a mandate on each term", read on a driver instead of on a coupling.

THE PER-DOMAIN FLOOR IS THE SAME QUARTER BASE PAIR. A 1.5-turn domain needs 540 deg; 16 bp of B-DNA gives 548.571 and 15 bp gives 514.286, so the CHEAPEST domain any integer lattice can build is misregistered by 8.571 deg — which is 0.25 bp of rotation, the same floor the whole-row residual has. A twist correction is therefore never a removal of register error; it is a choice of how many 25.714 deg domains to buy in order to cancel the accumulation of the cheap ones.

THE DESIGN MOVES, NOT ONLY ITS VALUE. On C-0086's 112 bp lattice the best 34-root centro-symmetric placement dishes 0.0621469 at zero prestrain and 0.0817325 under the graded field; on the 110 bp corrected lattice it dishes 0.0602892 and 0.0580196, and the winning SHAPE is NOT C-0090's. Every one of the four is inside T-5b's 0.10.

THE RE-READ IS A SCALING AND THE PROOF IS ONE LINE, WHICH IS WHY NO SWEEP WAS PAID FOR. u(+-L/2) = Delta_omega lambda tanh(L/2 lambda) and lambda = sqrt(C p/k) contains no Delta_omega, so the whole boundary layer is exactly linear in the driver; measured on the discrete chain, halving the mismatch halves every node to 0.0e+00. C-0107's twelve cells therefore re-read by multiplication.
